parameters.name: AlarmTaskId
parameters.description: The ID of the event-triggered task.

parameters.name: IsEnable
parameters.description:
Specifies whether the event-triggered task is enabled. Valid values:

- true: enabled.
- false: disabled.

parameters.name: MetricName
parameters.description: The name of the monitoring metric.

parameters.name: MetricType
parameters.description:
The type of the monitoring metric. Valid values:

- system: uses CloudMonitor system metrics.
- custom: uses custom metrics reported to CloudMonitor.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description:
The page number of the event-triggered task list. Minimum value: 1.

Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries per page for paging queries. Settings the number of rows per page. Maximum value: 50.

Default value: 10.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region where the event-triggered task resides.

parameters.name: ScalingGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the scaling group associated with the event-triggered task.

parameters.name: State
parameters.description:
The state of the event-triggered task. Valid values:

- ALARM: The alert condition is met.
- OK: The alert condition is not met.
- INSUFFICIENT_DATA: Insufficient data to determine whether the alert condition is met.
